# STEP test parts

## `nist_ctc_03_asme1_ap242-e2.stp`

- Source: NIST MBE PMI Validation and Conformance Testing Project, combined test case 3 (CTC-03),
  AP242 edition 2, <https://www.nist.gov/document/nist-pmi-step-files>
- SHA-256: `196b665776e759282f80fc8fb27d7bceb995df77cf78b7ce48347535a4d6cb5f`
- Retained byte for byte. NIST states the test files can be used without any restrictions and
  asks for an acknowledgement of the source, which this file gives.

Used by `tests/cad_direct_imported.rs`: Offset face on the part's large top face, whose edges are
rounds and fillets tangent to it.
